sources_considered.why: Pre-publication experiments address generalization in neural-symbolic training and prompting, but do not survey every available integrated system.

evidence_items.explanation: The experiments find weaknesses in specialized neural-symbolic training while finding better transfer from foundation-model prompting. This supports concern about generalization, but does not establish the claimed field-wide absence of dependable general integration.

AlphaGeometry2 combines a language model, symbolic engine, and search, reporting an 84% solve rate on 2000–2024 IMO geometry problems. Its restricted domain makes this an important qualification, rather than a demonstration of general integration.

unresolved_gaps: No representative evaluation establishes the historical capability across the range of integrated systems covered by the claim.
The available evidence does not supply an agreed boundary for reliable and general integration.
The cited evaluations predate the publication-date snapshot and are treated as context.
